description: Source code for the ue_cell_grid_allocator class, managing resource allocation for uplink and downlink in a 5G NR scheduler, including grant setup, resource calculation, and post-processing.

classes.name: ue_cell_grid_allocator
classes.description: Manages resource allocation for UEs in a 5G NR scheduler, including downlink/uplink grants, resource calculation, and post-processing.

classes.name: dl_newtx_grant_builder
classes.description: Helper class to set PDSCH parameters for a new downlink transmission grant.

classes.name: ul_newtx_grant_builder
classes.description: Helper class to set PUSCH parameters for a new uplink transmission grant.

methods.name: calculate_dl_mcs_tbs
methods.description: Calculates the downlink MCS and TBS based on resource allocation, CSI-RS presence, and carrier offset.

methods.name: alloc_dl_pdcch
methods.description: Allocates a downlink PDCCH for a UE, returning the PDCCH info or an error status.

methods.name: alloc_uci
methods.description: Allocates UCI (HARQ ACK, CSI, etc.) for a UE in a given search space.

methods.name: allocate_dl_grant
methods.description: Sets up a downlink grant for a new transmission, including PDCCH, PDSCH, and UCI allocations.

methods.name: setup_dl_grant_builder
methods.description: Creates a downlink grant info object with all necessary parameters for transmission.

methods.name: allocate_ul_grant
methods.description: Sets up an uplink grant for a new transmission, including PDCCH, PUSCH, and UCI allocations.

methods.name: setup_ul_grant_builder
methods.description: Creates an uplink grant info object with all necessary parameters for transmission.

methods.name: set_pdsch_params
methods.description: Configures PDSCH parameters and resource allocations for a downlink grant.

methods.name: set_pusch_params
methods.description: Configures PUSCH parameters and resource allocations for an uplink grant.

methods.name: post_process_results
methods.description: Removes cancelled grants and updates PUCCH power control results after resource allocation.

methods.name: post_process_pucch_pw_ctrl_results
methods.description: Updates HARQ-ACK PUCCH power control states based on scheduled grants.
